_comment: Frontline Heroism, part 1 of 3: the ETB half. 'When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste.' Board is THREE LANDS AND NOTHING ELSE -- no creatures at all -- so the deck has exactly zero power on board and the only possible source of damage is the token Heroism makes as it enters. Mountain + Rootbound Crag + Forest pays {2}{R} exactly. opponent_life 1 is therefore reachable if and only if (a) the ETB token is created (etb_self_creates_tokens) and (b) it carries HASTE (created_token_haste), letting it attack the turn Heroism resolves. Drop either and the board deals 0 and the game cannot be won by max_turns. This is the fixture that would have caught a token created without its haste keyword -- the failure mode that is invisible in aggregate win-turn numbers because the token still exists and still blocks/attacks a turn later.
